name: Stillwater
description: Siblings Karl, Addy and Michael have a very special next-door neighbor: a wise panda named Stillwater. His friendship and stories give them new perspectives on the world, themselves, and each other.

videos.title: The Impossible Dream / Stuck in the Rain
videos.overview: Karl builds a spaceship but no one thinks it will fly. An unwelcome summer rain gives Michael a new perspective on fun.

videos.title: Gift of Compassion / Larger Than Life
videos.overview: Addy gets frustrated with Karl for not sharing a game. Karl receives a toy robot that isn't what he expected.

videos.title: Soaked / A Perfect Fit
videos.overview: Karl and Michael feel badly after accidentally soaking Addy with water balloons. When Michael and Addy build a go-kart, Karl feels left out.

videos.title: Downward Dog / The Sleeping Moon
videos.overview: Michael is hired to pet-sit a neighbor's dog for the weekend. Things don't go as planned when the kids try to watch a lunar eclipse.

videos.title: The Race / Dressed Up
videos.overview: Addy feels sad after losing a cross-country race. Karl is unwilling to give up his favorite shirt, even though he's outgrown it.

videos.title: The Haircut / Paper Wings
videos.overview: Karl is afraid to visit a barber for the first time. Michael becomes determined to make the perfect paper airplane.

videos.title: Loud Colors / Tied up in Knots
videos.overview: Addy looks forward to a peaceful painting session with Stillwater. Karl finally ties his shoes by himself but worries he won't be able to do it again.

videos.title: Crossing Over / Kind of Blue
videos.overview: Karl faces his fear of crossing a creek in the woods. Michael sees that Addy looks sad and wants to cheer her up.

videos.title: Out on a Limb / Sandcastles
videos.overview: Karl accidentally breaks a branch on Stillwater's cherry tree. The kids try to protect their sandcastle from being washed away.

videos.title: The Unexpected Gift / Celebration Song
videos.overview: The kids think it's Stillwater's birthday and plan a surprise party. Addy is disappointed about not getting a lead role in the school play.

videos.title: The Trade / Winter Wonder
videos.overview: Michael is upset when Karl trades a rare game card. A homemade snow scooter leaves Michael feeling frustrated.

videos.title: Ghost Story
videos.overview: Michael feels abandoned on Halloween when Addy gets invited to a friend's party, and Karl decides to stay in because he's afraid of ghosts.

videos.title: The Way Home
videos.overview: While helping Stillwater make treats for the Winter Solstice Festival, the kids learn he plans to share some with a neighbor they're wary of.

videos.title: The Visit / Showtime
videos.overview: The arrival of Stillwater's niece Koo has Karl feeling a bit unseen. Addy puts on a show with her brothers but needs to learn to collaborate.

videos.title: Karl's Museum / The Helper
videos.overview: Karl is disappointed his gem museum doesn't attract more visitors. Addy's time with her classmates gets disrupted by Karl's antics.

videos.title: Band Aid / The Good Morning
videos.overview: Addy forms a band with her friends and discovers playing together is harder than she expected. Michael's day gets off to a rough start.

videos.title: Building Big / Falling Leaves
videos.overview: Michael feels overwhelmed by how long it'll take to build his dream treehouse. Karl copes with the loss of his favorite climbing tree.

videos.title: Stitch Marks / Friends Forever
videos.overview: Karl is upset that MuMu, his favorite stuffed toy, is “broken.” Addy feels betrayed when her best friend spends time with someone else.

videos.title: Hide and Seek / The Trip
videos.overview: Karl and Koo think of ways to make their playdate last forever. Stillwater is anxious about everything he has to do before his trip.

videos.title: One Drop Makes an Ocean
videos.overview: Stillwater shows the kids his worm farm and other things he does to live green, which inspires them to come up with more ways to help Earth.

videos.title: Waiting / Bake Sale
videos.overview: Karl's excitement for Stillwater's return makes the wait that much harder. Addy takes on too many requests for the school's bake sale.

videos.title: Captain Koo / Digging Deeper
videos.overview: Koo is caught off guard when Karl introduces her to his friends. Maya and Addy show Tommy kindness as he deals with the loss of a loved one.

videos.title: Tons of Fun / Apologies
videos.overview: Michael plans a fun day for Karl and Koo, but he wants them to play his way. Karl and Koo lose Michael's autographed baseball.

videos.title: Sounds Like Poetry / Birdwatching
videos.overview: Addy is offended when Michael doesn't like her poem. Michael buries his nose in a book during a group hike with Stillwater.

videos.title: New Neighbors / Koo's Gift
videos.overview: Michael is nervous about meeting the new kids across the street. Koo attends her first birthday party and is concerned about her gift.

videos.title: Friendly Wishes / Growing Together
videos.overview: With Addy home sick, Michael finds it difficult to enjoy a beach trip with Stillwater. A critter causes trouble in Addy and Maya's garden.

videos.title: The Catio / Campout
videos.overview: Michael, Molly, and Leo build Jasper a hideout, but he doesn't seem interested in it. Karl and Koo set off on a daring overnight adventure.

videos.title: Book Club / Treasure Hunt
videos.overview: Addy worries her new book club will find her favorite book too childish. Karl spends a day at the beach looking for buried treasure.

videos.title: The Catch / Missing Out
videos.overview: Michael gives himself a hard time for missing the game-winning catch. Addy feels left out when she isn't invited to a birthday dinner.

videos.title: I'm Bored / Art Fair
videos.overview: A bored Karl takes out his frustrations on everyone around him. Michael struggles to finish an art project for an upcoming fair.

videos.title: Good, Better, Best / Raking Leaves
videos.overview: Karl and Koo's competitive games start to ruin their fun. The kids rake Mr. Morgan's leaves, but a gust of wind undoes their hard work.

videos.title: Finders Keepers / Good Advice
videos.overview: Addy wonders how to handle a surprise find in her yard-sale purchase. Michael can't stop giving Addy “helpful” advice.

videos.title: Story Time / Ring the Bell
videos.overview: Karl gets upset when he reaches the end of his favorite book series. Addy sets an ambitious goal to get to the top of a climbing wall.

videos.title: Stage Fright / The Cast
videos.overview: Leo deals with stage fright on a project he's presenting with Michael. Karl envies the attention Emma gets from the cast on her arm.

videos.title: The Sleepover / Snow Day
videos.overview: Addy and her friends unknowingly make Lexi feel left out at a sleepover. Michael's complaints put a damper on Molly and Leo's first snowfall.

videos.title: Not Fair / Big for a Day
